title: Freeman, Siegel v. Spear, and early reliance categories
shortTitle: Freeman, Siegel v. Spear, and early reliance categories
summary: Land improvements and assurances during a gratuitous bailment appear in the history of reliance protection.
notes: The casebook uses these authorities to show protection before a generalized § 90 formulation. The relevant change of position must be tied to the assurance. A historical analogy does not establish that all bailments or family land promises satisfy the same modern test.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 123–126. Open assigned page 123.
